name: Weakpoint Lock-On
description: Moves the lock-on point of many enemies and structures to a weak point (heads, joints, fabricator frames), so lock-on weapons aim there. A fixed set of the options from Weakpoint Lock-On All-In-One 3.0 by potatoman7676 and 치킨맛참새 (used with their permission), packaged as a gameplay mod to work with Hellforge Rebalanced: every player must run the same files. Sentries, Arc and flame weapons use the same point.
